_comment: Read by Dev Tools (dt_core.py) at build time. All four tab modules are listed as hidden imports because main.py loads them by name (__import__ on a variable), which PyInstaller cannot see - without these the program starts with red 'tab could not be built' pages. in_t is still on the list although its page is no longer on the tab bar: it is built and kept alive, because main.log() writes into it. ov_t is on it twice over - ft_t imports ov_t._Row for the preview of the list. The ls_* modules are listed with them so their own imports are followed from a known root. The Qt exclusions are the same ones Image Tools and Announcer use; nothing here touches QML, Quick or 3D. No extra_files: the settings live in %APPDATA%\LaserSettings and there is nothing beside the exe to ship but icon.ico, which the builder adds by itself.
